$comment: Claude Code runtime settings for Claire. The prompt is portable/claude-code/agents/claire.md; this file is the config that has no business inside a prompt. Read agents/claire/PORTING.md before wiring any of it up — none of what follows is a data fence.
$toolsComment: Claire orchestrates and never reads a transcript herself, so she holds no read_file and no write tools — that is a deliberate omission, not an oversight. `@SLUG@` is the client slug, substituted once per client; one pair of MCP servers per client, named for that client, and Claire's own pre-flight check 1 refuses to work if they are absent.
$subagentsComment: Claire dispatches these four and does the pipeline work through them. They ship at portable/claude-code/agents/{scribe,lexicon,tagger,analyst}.md and each carries its own `tools` allowlist — that allowlist is the separation, not the prose. Substitute @SLUG@ in all five files with the same value.
